newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL assigns 'P1+' rating to PCL.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL assigns 'P1+' rating to PCL.

text.p: India's Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) on Wednesday reaffirmed its 'P1+' rating assigned to the 45-million-rupee Commercial Paper programme of Parry's Confectionery Limited (PCL).
The firm said this rating indicated that the degree of safety with regard to timely payment on the instrument was very strong.
Parry's Confectionery Limited (PCL), part of the Madras-based Murugappa group, makes "Parry's" brand sugar confectionery, and is the market leader in terms of both volume and value.
The company is expected to retain its market leadership with the introduction of new brands in the premium confectionery range where competition is relatively less, Crisil said.
PCL has reported an improvement in its financial performance for the year 1996/97 with an operating income of 1.17 billion rupees and a PAT of 74.3 million rupees, it added.
PCL is in the midst of an expansion-cum-modernisation project with a total outlay of 680 million rupees part of which has been funded through debt, Crisil said.
However, with healthy accretion to reserves, the gearing of the company is comfortable at 0.68 as at March 31, 1997, the rating agency added.
